resources.string: Installs community theme packs (.rwift or .zip files, as Rwiftkey uses them) without root: open or share a pack with SwiftKey, or pick one from Install theme pack in settings.
Removes Copilot, Bing Search, Microsoft Rewards, Image Creator, Camera Remix, and AI sticker generation from the keyboard and settings.
Stops usage telemetry, Adjust attribution tracking, and Firebase crash reporting.
Offers every extended Latin keyboard layout, such as BÉPO, Neo 2, and Swiss French QWERTZ, to every Latin-script language.
